name: The Raider Camp
summary: Human raiders from the coast have made camp in the forest south of the road. Break them before they hit the farms.

objectives.text: Break the raider camp in the forest at 6,12.

name: The Engineer
summary: A gnome engineer who can restart the old pumps needs safe conduct east along the road.

objectives.name: Engineer Tamsin
objectives.text: Bring Engineer Tamsin safely to Scrapmarch.

name: Letters for Grimcairn
summary: Carry sealed letters to the warden at Grimcairn, past the raiders on the road.

objectives.text: Deliver the letters to Grimcairn.

name: The Old Watchtower
summary: A beastman band has moved into the ruined watchtower in the hills. Find them and deal with them.

objectives.text: Find the old watchtower in the hills at 12,2.
Drive the beastmen out of the watchtower.

name: The Barrow-King's Torc
summary: Something guards the Old Barrow's lower hall, and the barrow-king's torc lies hidden above it. Bring the torc back.

objectives.text: Go down to the lower barrow.
Destroy the golems guarding the east hall of the lower barrow.
Find the barrow-king's torc in a hidden room of the upper barrow.

name: The Corpse-Road
summary: A hooded mourner must reach the mortuary at Scrapmarch with what she carries. See her there safely, and the crypt will give back one of your dead.

objectives.name: a hooded mourner
objectives.text: Bring the hooded mourner safely to Scrapmarch.

name: The Barrow-Bones
summary: Ysolde wants a finger-bone from the heaped bones of the lower barrow. Bring it to her, and the crypt will give back one of your dead.

objectives.text: Take a finger-bone from the heaped bones of the lower barrow.

name: The Pilgrimage to the High Cairn
summary: A pilgrim of the god of death must reach the burial cairns at Grimcairn. See them there safely, and the mortuary will send back one of your dead.

objectives.name: a death-pilgrim
objectives.text: Bring the death-pilgrim safely to Grimcairn.

name: The Corpse-Thieves
summary: Corpse-thieves are robbing the god's dead from the roadside graves south-east of town. Stop them, and the mortuary will send back one of your dead.

objectives.text: Stop the corpse-thieves at the graves at 21,10.

name: Bones for the Pits
summary: Vashti wants a cull horror's skull from the Gallows Wood. Bring it, and the crypt will give back one of your dead.

objectives.text: Kill the cull horror in the Gallows Wood at 4,16.

name: The Mourners' Road
summary: A goblin mourner must reach Mirewatch to bury her son. See her there safely, and the mortuary will send back one of your dead.

objectives.name: a goblin mourner
objectives.text: Bring the mourner safely to Mirewatch.

name: The Ashgate Rolls
summary: Ashgate Keep, out in the Ruinfields at 22,12, still flies the Dark Lord's banner, and its bound garrison still holds it. Bring back the keep's muster rolls: Gorvash wants to know whose orders it was built to follow.

objectives.text: Get down into Ashgate's undervaults.
Take the muster rolls from the keep's archive.

name: The Cull Records
summary: The rolls show Ashgate's beastmen came from the Mire Vats at 17,22, south of Mirewatch, along with the crafters' cull records. Whoever kept the vats kept count of every orc and goblin breed. Gorvash wants that count, and who it answered to.

objectives.text: Go down to the cull rooms under the Mire Vats.
Kill the cull horrors that still keep the cull pit.
Take the cull records from the room behind the pit.

name: Relief for the Ash Road
summary: The old goblin patrols on the hill roads stop every cart. Tikka's scribes have forged relief orders in the old style; carry them to Lanternfall, where the patrols report, and the patrols can finally stand down.

objectives.text: Carry the relief orders to Lanternfall.

name: Slavers in the Mire
summary: Slavers with beastman muscle have camped in the Mire at 15,21 and are taking road crews. Break the camp.

objectives.text: Break the slavers' camp in the Mire at 15,21.

name: The Lieutenant's Seal
summary: The cull records answered to Lieutenant Vael, whose war bunker is in the Ash Mountains at 20,2. Vael was trusted with the Seal of Command. Gorvash wants it out of that bunker before a warlord gets there first.

objectives.text: Get down to the bunker's command deck.
Take the Seal of Command from Vael's vault.

name: The Warlord Falls
summary: Warlord Grisk holds a stockade in Gallows Wood at 2,21, a crafter to breed his army, and he has heard about the seal. Strike before his herds give birth.

objectives.text: Fight down to the warlord's hall.
Kill Warlord Grisk on his throne.

name: The Emptied Crypts
summary: With Grisk dead, the Faithful have come down out of the hills. They are emptying the Lady's crypts and carting the dead north, and Gorvash wants to know why. Raid the Ember Shrine.

objectives.text: Go down into the Ember Shrine's ossuary.
Defeat the keeper of the shrine.
Take the pilgrim map from the keeper's table.

name: The Salt Tithe
summary: Thornwatch pays its salt tithe in bread for the Saltgate. Carry the salt across the flats before the bread runs out.

objectives.text: Deliver the salt to Thornwatch.

name: The Unquiet Field
summary: The Faithful have raised the dead of the last battle before the capital, and they are walking. Lay them down, and Sister Orla will send one of yours back.

objectives.text: Lay the dead to rest on the battlefield at 15,8.

name: The Countermand
summary: Nim's mother still holds the Saltgate, as she was ordered the day the capital fell. The order was written in the Night Archive, and so, he hopes, was its countermand.

objectives.text: Go down to the Night Archive's sealed stacks.
Find the countermand for the Saltgate.

name: The Faithful's Ledger
summary: The pilgrim map ends at the Night Archive. Sefa says the Faithful keep their ledger in its sealed stacks: every body taken, and what it is for.

objectives.text: Go down to the Night Archive's sealed stacks.
Defeat the keeper guarding the ledger.
Take the Faithful's ledger.

name: The Hollow Throne
summary: The ledger names the night: the Hierophant means to seat a regent on the Dark Lord's empty throne, with the Lady's dead for an army. Stop the Hierophant in the Hollow Citadel.

objectives.text: Reach the throne room of the Hollow Citadel.
Defeat the Hierophant before the throne.

name: The East Road
summary: Rubblegate has no harder work to give. Halda writes the party a letter for Elder Gorvash in Cinderhold, down the east road into the Dark Lands, where the work is harder and pays better.

objectives.item: Reeve Halda's letter to Elder Gorvash
objectives.text: Take the east road into the Dark Lands and bring the letter to Cinderhold.

name: The Throne Road
summary: The Dark Lands have little left that would trouble the party. Tikka has a letter for Archivist Sefa in Saltwick, up the Throne Road past Lanternfall, where bound orcs still hold the pass.

objectives.item: Foreman Tikka's letter to Archivist Sefa
objectives.text: Take the Throne Road north into the Pale Reach and bring the letter to Saltwick.

name: The Warden Below
summary: Goats come down from the high pass frozen stiff, and the barrow-wardens' sepulchre in the mountains at 15,1 stands open. Osk says the last warden never died: a sorcerer who kept the Old Barrow's wards in his own bones. Put him in the ground for good.

objectives.text: Go down to the warden's vault.
Destroy the lich and his honor guard in the vault.
Take the lich's phylactery, so he cannot rise again.

name: The Red Hunger
summary: Saltwick's woodcutters are coming home pale, or not at all, and the ones buried last month dug themselves out. Sister Orla follows the trail to Mourncourt, a sealed manor in the deep forest at 2,3. Kill the vampires feeding there.

objectives.text: Kill the vampires feasting in Mourncourt's dining hall.

name: The Lord of Mourncourt
summary: The vampire you killed was only a child of the house. Its maker, the eldest of the line, sleeps in the blood crypt under Mourncourt and has fed on the Pale Reach for six hundred years. Send it to the Lady.

objectives.text: Go down to Mourncourt's blood crypt.
Destroy the master of Mourncourt in its sealed hall.

name: The Cistern Hydra
summary: Something with too many heads lairs in the flooded imperial cisterns at 14,22 and hunts the Mire's ferry lanes at night. Grut wants it dead, and she has saved for a long time to pay for it.

objectives.text: Go down to the hydra's pool.
Kill the hydra in its pool.

name: The Mere Hydra
summary: A pair of hydras has come up out of the Pale Mere into the reed beds at 21,11, where the salt barges land. Brask has lost a barge and its crew. Kill them before the next one sails.

objectives.text: Kill the hydras in the reed beds at 21,11.
